objects.taxonomy_description: Croissant（牛角包）是一种具有特定几何形态和表面纹理的烘焙面点，不属于生物分类范畴。

diagnostic_checkpoints.整体形态: 呈现标志性的新月形或角状弯曲结构，两端尖细，中间膨大。
diagnostic_checkpoints.表面纹理: 表面具有清晰可见的层状剥离结构（千层酥皮），显示出面团折叠烘烤后的分层特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.色泽特征: 整体呈均匀的金黄色至深褐色，表面通常带有烘烤产生的光泽，无生物表皮特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.结构完整性: 为单一连续的固体食物单元，无头尾、四肢或器官等生物解剖结构。

objects.taxonomy_description: Large wading bird measuring 120-145 cm in height with wingspan reaching 140-170 cm. Plumage ranges from pale pink to vivid scarlet depending on diet, with darker coloration on wings and tail. Neck is extremely elongated and S-curved, comprising approximately one-third of total body length. Bill is distinctive with downward-curving shape, deep black at tip transitioning to pale pink at base, adapted for filter-feeding. Legs are exceptionally long and bright pink to red with webbed feet. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with compact torso contrasting elongated neck and legs. Wings display black primary feathers visible during flight. Flight posture features full neck extension. Juveniles display grey-white plumage developing pink coloration over 2-3 years. Weight ranges 2-4 kg.

Head_and_Face: Bill is distinctive with downward-curving shape, deep black at tip transitioning to pale pink at base.
Head is small relative to extremely elongated neck.
Eyes are dark and positioned on small head.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage ranges from pale pink to vivid scarlet with darker coloration on wings and tail.
Body exhibits compact torso contrasting elongated neck and legs.
Wings display black primary feathers visible during flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are exceptionally long and bright pink to red with webbed feet.
Neck is extremely elongated and S-curved, comprising approximately one-third of total body length.
Flight posture features full neck extension.

objects.taxonomy_description: 长颈鹿属于偶蹄目长颈鹿科，是现存最高的陆生哺乳动物，以其极长的颈部和独特的骨皮角为显著特征。

diagnostic_checkpoints.颈部: 拥有极度延长的颈部，长度显著超过身体其他部分，用于高处取食。
diagnostic_checkpoints.头部: 头顶具有一对或多对被皮肤和毛发覆盖的骨质突起（骨皮角），而非分叉的骨质鹿角或中空牛角。
diagnostic_checkpoints.四肢: 四肢修长且比例均匀，前肢通常略长于后肢，支撑高大的身躯。
diagnostic_checkpoints.体态: 整体轮廓呈现明显的前高后低倾斜姿态，肩部隆起高于臀部。
